risk_summary: The disclosure is reasonably quantified regarding revenue, margins, restructuring costs, and market-driven declines, but contains substantial standard forward-looking and accounting boilerplate. Credit risk is elevated by reduced oil and gas demand, declining backlog and revenues, project delays, cost overruns, contractual execution issues, restructuring, and continued weakness in Canadian operations. Improved gross margins and operational efficiencies provide some mitigation, but the overall tone remains cautious and negative.
